claim_text: High-dose omega-3 supplementation may affect bleeding risk and can interact with anticoagulant or antiplatelet treatment; dose and medication context should be reviewed before use.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People using anticoagulants or antiplatelet medicines and considering omega-3 supplements.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet summarizes safety and medication considerations.
limitations: Do not generalize risk to normal food intake; no dose from this claim.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
